cv_contract.split_type: temporal split by interval_end_timestamp (train = earliest 70%, val = next 15%, test = latest 15%)
cv_contract.grouping: grouped CV by wheelset_equipment_id; no wheelset may appear in more than one fold
cv_contract.leakage_rule: label horizon strictly after interval_end_timestamp; features point-in-time safe; identifiers (locomotive_number, wheelset_equipment_id, measurement ids) removed from model features
cv_contract.reproducibility: fixed random_state recorded per run; identical splits for every model in a phase

binary_classification.imbalance_rule: imbalance is evaluated via PR-AUC and precision@k; do NOT resample away from population prevalence in baseline phase

secondary: calibration plot at fixed horizons (30/90/180/365 d)
KM strata by predicted risk group
metrics.baseline: predict population median time-to-event for all rows (C-index = 0.5 sanity)

reporting.error_analysis: worst-100-rows diagnostics stratified by shed, wheel profile, interval length, turning events, missing RTIS, extreme wear (Phase 4, not SHAP-only)

governance.freeze_rule: evaluation outputs are versioned and never overwritten; new data/features produce a new evaluation run, not an in-place edit
governance.eligibility: models may consume only features released through the Training Eligibility Filter
